gamerule.bearmetalcarts.allow_chunkloadi: Whether minecarts load chunks: disallow, while_moving (only moving carts), or allow (moving carts plus a 3x3 area around carts that just stopped).
gamerule.bearmetalcarts.mobile_loading_d: How long, in ticks, chunks stay loaded after a moving minecart last touched them.
gamerule.bearmetalcarts.station_loading_: How long, in ticks, the 3x3 chunk area around a minecart stays loaded after it stops moving.
